annotations.title: ProntoFax: look up a verified fax number

description: Find the fax number for a US state or federal agency, with the official source it was read from and when it was last verified. Covers Social Security field offices across 56 states and territories (search by city or state), MassHealth, California EDD, Illinois IDES, NJ FamilyCare, IRS Form 2553, FEMA, the state unemployment agencies of Alabama, Colorado, Indiana, Iowa, Kentucky, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, South Carolina, Texas, Wisconsin, and the state Medicaid agencies of Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Louisiana, Montana, Nebraska, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas, Utah, Washington. It has no numbers for any other agency. Social Security and Medicaid publish no national fax number, so a lookup for either needs a city or a state. Returns nothing rather than guessing when it has no verified number for an agency.

agency.description: The agency to look up, in the user's own words, for example "MassHealth", "Texas Workforce Commission" or "social security office in Denver".

city.description: City or town, used to pick a Social Security field office. Optional.

language.description: Language for the response. Defaults to English.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example TX. Optional, and the only place a bare code is read.
